description: This file defines the QueryAggregateInterface, an interface for building and executing aggregated entity queries in Drupal. It includes method signatures for aggregation, grouping, conditions, sorting, and execution of aggregate queries.

classes.name: QueryAggregateInterface
classes.description: An interface for constructing and executing aggregated entity queries, extending QueryInterface with methods for aggregation, grouping, conditions, sorting, and execution.

methods.name: aggregate
methods.description: Specifies a field and a function to aggregate on, such as SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, COUNT.

methods.name: groupBy
methods.description: Specifies the field to group the results by.

methods.name: conditionAggregate
methods.description: Sets a condition for an aggregated value, with support for various operators.

methods.name: existsAggregate
methods.description: Queries for the existence of a field with an aggregate function.

methods.name: notExistsAggregate
methods.description: Queries for the nonexistence of a field with an aggregate function.

methods.name: conditionAggregateGroupFactory
methods.description: Creates an object holding a group of conditions with specified conjunction (AND/OR).

methods.name: sortAggregate
methods.description: Sorts results by an aggregated value in ascending or descending order.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the aggregate query and returns the result set.
